description: Money moved, or is about to. One transaction is one record: send every stage with the same universalId.

payee.description: The other side, as an entity: a payee, a merchant, a destination address. This is what links two customers who pay the same account.

device.description: The device the transaction was made from.

direction.description: Whether money came in or went out.

amount.description: The amount, in one unit throughout. Do not mix cents and whole units.

memo.description: Free text from the customer. Send it as written.

record.description: A later stage needs only what changed.
